title: A partial issue workspaceStrategy REPLACES the project's rather than merging, silently

incident.mechanism: execution-workspace-policy.js:275 combines the issue strategy with the project's using ?? , not a merge. A partial issue strategy therefore drops branchTemplate and worktreeParentDir and lands the run on a default branch inside the operator's own repository — untracked noise, and outside the isolation the design depends on.

trigger: an issue git_worktree strategy missing any of baseRef, branchTemplate, worktreeParentDir
assertion: config load refuses, naming the missing field and the ?? semantics
